Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: get `tests/inventory_parity.py` green on `orchestrator/project-9394` (issue #9582)

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-9394` at `06d41f9494d07eff489d00525c461d82020555e2`. Integration branch mismatch is `false`. I read a filtered snapshot of that ref, plus `isolated-base` for the default branch.

### What the ref shows
- **Failure 1 is already fixed on this ref, so no test edit is planned.** The parity-base test is `test_ci_runs_this_suite_and_sets_the_parity_base_only_from_the_pr_event` in `tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py` (lines 684–696). It already accepts both `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA` forms: every assignment must be one of the two allowed strings, and it requires `ci.count(pr_event_or_final_ci) == 6`. I re-ran its assertions against the current `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  - 7 assignments, all in the allowed set.
  - 6 with the `|| env.CI_FINAL_PR_BASE_SHA` fallback.
  - `mark-stable.yml` and `test-and-mark-stable.yml` still have no `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA`.

  It passes. Commit 4325d9b (#9566) landed it after the failing head `3da4a74`. pytest is not installed in this sandbox, so I checked the assertions by hand.
- **Failure 2 still happens on this ref and on `isolated-base`.** I ran `python3 tests/inventory_parity.py`. It reports that `docs/INVENTORY.md` is missing:
  - `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` and `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, the two the issue names.
  - `.github/workflows/ci_pr_quick.yml` and `scripts/ci_docs_only_paths.sh`. These two came with the later #9528 switch-over and the docs-only final-CI change. All four files exist on the ref.

  Adding only the two scripts the issue names would leave the guard red. Adding all four is what turns it green.
- **Conflict note: one failure is a snapshot artefact, not a real problem.** `inventory_parity` also prints `unexpected .github/workflows/propagate-consumer-secrets.yml`. The sandbox drops files with credential-like names, and that workflow is absent from both the snapshot and `isolated-base`'s tree listing. Its entry in `docs/INVENTORY.md` (line 89) must NOT be removed.

## Files likely to change
- `docs/INVENTORY.md`

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/inventory_parity.py red-on-base
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py::test_ci_runs_this_suite_and_sets_the_parity_base_only_from_the_pr_event
ACCEPTANCE: check lint
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml job lint

## Functions or modules to implement
No code changes. Add four bullets to `docs/INVENTORY.md`, each in the existing `` - `path` — description. `` shape.

1. **`## Workflows` section:** add a bullet right after the `.github/workflows/ci.yml` entry (line 54) and before `clarify.yml`:
   - `` - `.github/workflows/ci_pr_quick.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow: <the file's top-level `name:` value>. ``
   - The changelog fragment calls it `CI quick`. Use the exact `name:` from the file, following the convention of the neighbouring entries.
   - You may add one clause, e.g. "runs `ci.yml`'s `static-checks` job on every PR push (`quick / ...` checks; never reports `lint`)".
2. **`## Scripts` section:** add a bullet after `scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py` (line 144) and before `scripts/clarify_base_image_preseed.sh`:
   - `` - `scripts/ci_docs_only_paths.sh` — `ci_docs_only_path_is_safe`: the list of paths whose changes let `_pr_ensure_final_ci` dispatch `ci.yml` with `docs_only=true` (test jobs skip; `lint` re-checks the merge ref). ``
3. **`## Scripts` section:** add two bullets just before `scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh` (line 304), keeping alphabetical order. The text follows the issue's wording and `changelog.d/9528-ci-once-at-end-of-review.md`:
   - `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` — `final-ci-failed` job in `ci.yml`: when a final-CI dispatch run's `lint` fails, posts one `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker per head and dispatches the PR's review workflow (`FINAL_CI_FAILED_REDISPATCH_ENABLED`). ``
   - `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` — review sweep step "Ensure the final CI run on reviewed PR heads": starts the missing final CI run for reviewed PR heads (`FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`). ``

Do not touch any other line. Do not reorder or reword existing entries, and do not remove the `propagate-consumer-secrets.yml` entry.

## Data structures affected
None. The only change is the documentation inventory that `tests/inventory_parity.py` parses.

## API or interface changes
None. No workflow, script, env var, or log prefix changes.

## Decisions
### D1 — Document all four missing surfaces, not just the two named in the issue
- Chosen: add entries for `review_final_ci_failed.sh`, `review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, `ci_pr_quick.yml` and `ci_docs_only_paths.sh`.
- Alternatives considered: add only the two scripts in the issue's suggested fix, or file follow-up issues for the other two.
- Why: on the current ref, `inventory_parity` fails on all four. Fixing two would leave `lint` red, and the issue's goal is a green `lint`. The two extra bullets are a tiny docs change (≤2 lines) with no new interface.

### D2 — No change to `tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py`
- Chosen: leave the test as it is.
- Alternatives considered: apply the issue's suggested `plain == 1` / `with_final == 6` / total `== 7` assertions.
- Why: the planning ref already carries an equivalent, stricter fix: allowed-set membership plus a pinned count of 6. It passes against the current `ci.yml`. Editing it again would be churn, and it could conflict with #9566.

### D3 — No change to the `tests-system-python` job-level env in `ci.yml`
- Chosen: leave line 3961 (`CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}`) as it is.
- Alternatives considered: add the `|| env.CI_FINAL_PR_BASE_SHA` fallback.
- Why: the issue calls this a follow-up "outside this failure" that needs an intent check. Changing it would also break the pinned count of 6 in the parity test, and it touches a heavily contended workflow file (several open PRs edit `ci.yml`).

## Security considerations
- **Trust boundaries:** none crossed. This is a docs-only edit to a tracked inventory file, with no executable change, secret, or credential.
- **Authorization:** no new endpoint or surface.
- **External input:** the description text is copied from changelog fragments already in the repo. Do not paste untrusted issue or CI-log text beyond the descriptions above.
- **Abuse cases:** none. The guard is not weakened or removed, and the entry for the snapshot-filtered `propagate-consumer-secrets.yml` stays, so the inventory still matches the real tree.

## Potential risks or edge cases
- **Duplicate or conflicting work:** open PRs #9597 (issue #9581) and #9598 (issue #9580) touch `docs/INVENTORY.md`, probably to add some of the same entries on `main`. If both land, the main→integration sync may hit a text conflict on the same lines. Identical bullets merge cleanly, so use the wording above verbatim.
- **Unit of the test:** `inventory_parity` may also check that a referenced surface really exists, so make sure the four paths are spelled exactly as in the tree.
- **Snapshot vs. real tree:** the `propagate-consumer-secrets.yml` "unexpected" failure is local to the sandbox. Real CI has the file and will not report it.
- **Follow-up still open:** on final-CI dispatch runs, `tests-system-python` runs parity without the PR-base fallback (D3). That stays unaddressed here.

## Testing considerations
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/inventory_parity.py`: must print no `FAIL:` line for the four paths. In real CI it must exit 0. In this sandbox only the `propagate-consumer-secrets.yml` artefact line may remain.
- `pytest tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py -k parity_base`: must stay green. It is listed as a regression guard, not red-on-base.
- `python3 tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py`: must stay green. The edit does not touch `ci.yml`.
- No new tests and no changelog fragment. This is an internal docs-inventory fix, and no CI gate requires a fragment.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends docs/INVENTORY.md entry convention (enforced by tests/inventory_parity.py)
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for the smallest change that turns CI `lint` green on `orchestrator/project-9394` without weakening a guard. On this ref, the parity-test half is already delivered (#9566), so it needs no edit. The inventory half needs four bullets rather than two, because the same guard also reports `ci_pr_quick.yml` and `ci_docs_only_paths.sh` as missing. The complete fix costs two extra docs lines, adds no dependency or interface, and is the only version that makes the guard pass. That follows §6: Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed, and completeness serves correctness. The `ci.yml:3961` fallback stays out of scope, as the issue itself marks it.
